recommendations.recommendation: Give up craving and cultivate contentment, since desire is never satisfied by fulfilling it.
recommendations.rationale: Craving grows with indulgence and only keeps one restless.

recommendations.recommendation: Treat learning as the finest wealth, which cannot be stolen and grows when shared.
recommendations.rationale: Knowledge is imperishable unlike material riches.

recommendations.recommendation: Keep company with the wise and good, and stay away from fools.
recommendations.rationale: Company shapes character; fools cannot be reasoned with.

recommendations.recommendation: Give wealth generously, since it is otherwise lost or merely enjoyed.
recommendations.rationale: Wealth has three fates: giving, enjoyment, or loss.

recommendations.recommendation: Withdraw from sensual pleasures and turn toward renunciation and devotion to Shiva.
recommendations.rationale: Pleasures are fleeting and end in decay and death.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not be proud of youth, beauty, or power, because they pass quickly.
Practice patience and forbearance, which adorn the strong.
recommendations.rationale: Forbearance is a mark of true strength.

recommendations.recommendation: Be wary of the snares of sexual attraction.
recommendations.rationale: Passion binds and ruins the unwary.
